name: Masakazu Morita
bio: ​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Masakazu Morita (born October 21, 1972) is a seiyū and actor born in Tokyo, Japan. He is the host of the radio show Bleach B-Station. Morita is perhaps best known for his roles as Ichigo Kurosaki (Bleach), Tidus (Final Fantasy X), Auel Neider (Gundam Seed Destiny), Pegasus Seiya (Saint Seiya Hades: Chapter Inferno), Troy Bolton (Japanese versions of High School Musical and High School Musical 2), and Chili (Pokémon). According to Bleach author Tite Kubo, he's "overly energetic", but "very friendly and open".
